draft.shortGloss: to play; to have fun; to play with
draft.emotion: lighthearted and carefree, looking forward to some fun
notes: In northern China, this is usually pronounced and written with erhua: 玩儿 (wánr).
Do not use 玩 for most ball sports or musical instruments: use 打 (dǎ) or 踢 (tī) for sports (打篮球 'play basketball', 踢足球 'play soccer') and 弹 (tán) for instruments (弹钢琴 'play the piano').
